sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- The recorder is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: The recorder must be equipped to play found audio tapes (Default keybind: M) in raid. Collected audio tapes can also be listened to in the handbook without having the recorder equipped.
